prompt:
We have a serious compliance deadline coming up. Our legacy payment processing codebase at `/workspace/legacy_payment_system` has never been formally audited and we need a structured audit package delivered before end of quarter.

Please coordinate a full technical audit of that codebase. The audit needs to cover at least three separate concern areas — security vulnerabilities, regulatory/PCI-DSS compliance issues, and performance bottlenecks — and each area should be investigated independently and in parallel. Once all the investigation work is done, pull everything together into a single consolidated audit report and then clean up after yourself, archiving any working materials you created along the way.

The final consolidated report should be saved as `audit_report.md`. All working materials and intermediate outputs should be properly archived.
